mapper.select: SELECT r.id, i.type, i.img_url, i.rep_img_yn, u.birthday, u.gender, r.title, r.location, GROUP_CONCAT(h.hashtag) AS hashtags FROM review r JOIN user u ON r.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT owner_id, type, img_url, rep_img_yn FROM image WHERE type = 'review' AND rep_img_yn = 'Y' ) i ON r.id = i.owner_id JOIN hashtag h ON r.id = h.review_id GROUP BY r.id, i.type, i.img_url, i.rep_img_yn, u.birthday, u.gender, r.title, r.location

SELECT r.id, i.type, i.img_url, i.rep_img_yn, u.birthday, u.gender, r.title, r.location, GROUP_CONCAT(h.hashtag) AS hashtags FROM review r JOIN user u ON r.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT owner_id, type, img_url, rep_img_yn FROM image WHERE type = 'review' AND rep_img_yn = 'Y' ) i ON r.id = i.owner_id JOIN hashtag h ON r.id = h.review_id WHERE r.id IN ( SELECT review_id FROM hashtag WHERE hashtag LIKE CONCAT('%', #{hashtag}, '%') ) GROUP BY r.id, i.type, i.img_url, i.rep_img_yn, u.birthday, u.gender, r.title, r.location

SELECT r.id, r.user_id, r.title, r.companion, r.location, r.rating, r.content, r.date, u.nickname, u.birthday, u.gender, COUNT(rl.id) AS like_count, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT i.img_url) AS img_urls, GROUP_CONCAT(h.hashtag) AS hashtags FROM review r JOIN user u ON r.user_id = u.id JOIN hashtag h ON r.id = h.review_id LEFT JOIN review_likes rl ON r.id = rl.review_id LEFT JOIN image i ON i.owner_id = r.id AND i.type = 'REVIEW' WHERE r.id = #{id} GROUP BY r.id, r.title, r.companion, r.location, r.rating, r.content, r.date, u.nickname, u.birthday, u.gender
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM review_likes WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND review_id = #{reviewId}
mapper.select: SELECT r.id, i.type, i.img_url, i.rep_img_yn, u.birthday, u.gender, r.title, r.location, GROUP_CONCAT(h.hashtag) AS hashtags FROM review r JOIN user u ON r.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT owner_id, type, img_url, rep_img_yn FROM image WHERE type = 'review' AND rep_img_yn = 'Y' ) i ON r.id = i.owner_id JOIN hashtag h ON r.id = h.review_id WHERE r.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR h.hashtag LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') GROUP BY r.id, i.type, i.img_url, i.rep_img_yn, u.birthday, u.gender, r.title, r.location
SELECT DISTINCT h.hashtag FROM review r JOIN hashtag h ON r.id = h.review_id WHERE r.user_id = #{userId};
